component.name: Moreya
component.summary: Keep a dungeon and break the guild raids through the Moreya gate

description.p: Moreya is an open source real-time strategy game set underground. As the keeper of a dungeon you dig, claim and mine, build rooms, traps and doors, attract creatures and lead them into battle by dropping them where they are needed, casting spells and luring enemies into traps. In the campaign the guilds raid your dungeon through the Moreya gate.
